[[File:Chris Libey portrait.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Chris Libey.]]
'''Chris Libey''' was Decipher [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]] Gold 88 in Blacksburg, VA, later Richmond, VA. The slot is marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

His profile was a short greeting as the new Gold 88.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
Hello everyone! Nice to see ya! My name is Chris Libey and I'm Gold 88!

I'm glad to be joining the squadron and can't wait to keep up the tradition set before me - Star Wars CCG and fun!<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
